Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; character screen-centered, world scrolls; speed ≈75–80px/s (2.0s ≈150–160px), diagonal movement appears normalized/slower than axis-aligned. Space = Do Action (contextual pick/examine). LMB = Primary (used to pick), RMB = Secondary. F = Do Attack (effect on mobs untested). Esc = Pause menu (Continue/Controls/Settings/Save and Quit); pausing halts clock; Esc while craft panel open closes panel AND opens pause. Continue button requires a click to resume. Tab toggles Map (works). Caps Lock (Open Crafting per Controls page 3) could not be sent as an input in this environment—craft panel must be opened by clicking sidebar icons/labels with the mouse. '1' = Inv 1. Q/E rotate camera; scroll zooms. Controls pages advance with right arrow.

HOVER/PICK (observed): hovering shows verb labels at long range (200–300px+), so use hover to scout before walking. Picking requires roughly ≤100–130px; ~150px borderline/fails; >150px fails. Standing on a target flips Pick→Examine; step off and retry. Hotbar updates lag by a slot or so; icons eventually appear (counts often unreadable). Tooltips on hotbar rarely render. Craft tiles: hovering dark silhouettes gives no tooltip/highlight; clicking them silently fails.

YIELDS (observed): yellow and red flowers→Petals; grass tuft→Cut Grass x1; leafy sapling→Twigs x1; berry bush→Berries x1. Each pick gave 1 item. Loose sticks/twig sprites lying on ground read 'Examine Sapling' = depleted and yield nothing. Small yellow-green ground objects may read 'Pick up Seeds' (food item, not grass).

IDENTIFICATION (observed, corrections): bright tall yellow-green spiky plants = grass tufts ('Pick Grass'). Leafy saplings with broad leaf clumps = fresh saplings→Twigs. Bare/bent twiggy sprigs can still be harvestable ('Pick Sapling')—hover to distinguish. Flat bent twig sprites on open ground = depleted ('Examine Sapling'). Harvested grass becomes low stub ('Examine Grass'); harvested saplings become bare branching twigs. Pine needles and trunks both read 'Examine Evergreen' and can mimic yellow-green tufts. Many bright-looking tufts at pine bases are already depleted—always hover first. Depleted grass/twig stubs are extremely common in the starting savanna.

CRAFT UI (observed repeatedly): flame/Light sidebar icon at x≈0.019–0.022, y≈0.17–0.20; Tools icon at y≈0.10–0.145. Clicking a sidebar icon switches category. Categories seen: Tools (pickaxe/axe bright/craftable, others padlocked) and Light (campfire-, firepit-, torch-like dark silhouettes plus bright decorative end-cap tiles). Clicking the Light icon again does not obviously close the panel; movement still works with panel open. Craft UI open does NOT pause time. Hypothesis (unverified): dark silhouettes = unaffordable/locked; a recipe turns bright when affordable; bright end-cap tiles are decorative. CRITICAL empirical finding: holding 2 Twigs + 1 Cut Grass, all Light recipes were still dark—a torch appears to require more than that (likely 2 Cut Grass + 2 Twigs). Whether the recipe column scrolls remains unknown. Padlocked Tools recipes likely need a Science Machine.

NIGHT (observed): a blue moon icon appears beside the Day clock at dusk; then message 'It's getting late. It will be dark soon.' Then 'It's so dark!' with near-black screen. In an earlier attempt, darkness brought repeated 'OW! Something hit me!'/'What was that?!' and red damage vignette until death. Being without light means death. Opening/using the craft panel after dark wasted the remaining time and did not save the character. A lit torch held through daylight let a prior attempt survive Night 1. Scene visibly darkens/reddens before the moon icon—treat darkening as final warning. Night fell on Day 1 itself and arrived quickly.

HUNGER (observed): 'I'm so hungry!' warning appears; Petals hover shows 'Eat'. Whether eating restores hunger is untested; Seeds are pickable food.

TERRAIN/NAVIGATION (observed): start = open burrow-heavy brown ground with rabbit holes, flowers, red mushrooms, butterflies, birds, sparse saplings and scattered pines with grass tufts at trunk bases (frequently depleted). Long east/southeast runs = burrow savanna with little fresh grass. Dense pine grove west/southwest had plentiful grass but many bare depleted saplings. A richer cluster field (several grass tufts, a sapling, red and yellow flowers) was found after long travel west/southwest—best known harvesting area. Map (Tab) showed only a small explored green blob; nearly all world unexplored; no obvious biome boundary at this map zoom. Red birds roam, including one very large red bird; hostility unknown—avoid. Black birds appear inert so far.

FAILED/WASTEFUL (observed): repeated clicking of dark silhouette recipe tiles; hovering craft tiles/hotbar for tooltips; long walks toward labeled targets already known to be out of range; standing on pickables (flips to Examine); treating all twiggy plants as depleted (and vice versa); assuming flat twig sprites are pickable; trusting immediate hotbar updates; pressing Esc expecting to close the craft panel; wandering through already-harvested savanna hoping for fresh grass; ignoring the darkening scene while searching for a last grass tuft.

LESSONS/HYPOTHESES (unverified): daylight is a hard deadline arriving on Day 1—do not count on having a full day. Gather Cut Grass aggressively and early (aim for 3–4, since 2 may barely suffice), plus ≥2 Twigs, and craft a torch in early/mid afternoon while visibility and time remain, rather than hunting a final grass at dusk. Use hover-label scouting to pick the nearest valid targets and to avoid depleted stubs. Fresh grass is likeliest at pine bases and in the denser pine grove west/southwest; the starting savanna is heavily depleted. Berry bushes for food; test eating petals/berries/seeds when hunger warns. Campfire/fire pit costs unknown—a torch is the assumed minimal light source. Open questions: blue moon icon meaning; eating mechanics; F attack utility; craft column scrolling; campfire/fire pit costs; Science Machine availability; whether tooltips can ever render.
